question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Brittle
solution:
The correct answer is: '**Option 4: Resilient'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Brittle'** (नाज़ुक) refers to something that has a hard but liable to break or shatter easily. 
 
• **For example: **"Glass is a brittle material."
 
• **'Resilient'** (मजबूत), the correct antonym, refers to the ability to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions, also suggests flexibility. 
 
• **For example: **"Rubber is a resilient material."

Therefore, the **correct answer** is 'Option 4: Resilient'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Delicate'** (सूक्ष्म) often describes something that is fine in texture or structure and needs careful handling.
 
• **'Bitter'** (कड़वा) describes something with a sharp, pungent taste or smell.
 
• **'Attractive'** (आकर्षक) refers to something pleasing or appealing to the senses.
